facts.fact: Haj 2027 applications opened on 22 June 2026, when the Ministry of Minority Affairs announced the Haj Policy 2027 and the Haj Committee of India began inviting applications
facts.quote: released the policy and announced that the Haj Committee of India would, from today, invite applications from prospective pilgrims for Haj-2027.

facts.fact: Applications are made online through the Haj Committee of India portal (hajcommittee.gov.in) or the Haj Suvidha App
facts.quote: Prospective pilgrims can apply for Haj-2027 online through the Haj Committee of India portal (hajcommittee.gov.in) as well as the Haj Suvidha App

facts.fact: The closing date for Haj 2027 applications in the Guidelines was 20.07.2026
facts.quote: b. Closing Date: The closing date for submission of HAF shall be 20.07.2026.

facts.fact: Haj Committee Circular No. 3 of 20.07.2026 extended the last date for Haj applications and covered the Qurrah (draw) and advance Haj payment, so the application window is now closed
facts.quote: 3 3 2026-07-20 Extension of Last Date for Haj Application, Conduct of Qurrah and Payment of Advance Haj Amount
facts.note: 'Now closed' is derived: the circular moves on to the Qurrah and advance payment stages; the circulars page lists no later reopening (28 Oct 2026).

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; gives the Haj 2027 application dates as published by the Haj Committee of India / Ministry of Minority Affairs with the source and date, and says the application window has already closed; if it cannot find the date, says so rather than guessing.
fail_if: Says Haj 2027 applications have not opened yet or are still open, or gives a start date without an official source.
summary: Haj 2027 applications opened 22 June 2026 (PIB) online via hajcommittee.gov.in / Haj Suvidha App; closing date 20.07.2026, extended by Circular 3 (scanned, extended date not readable); window now closed.
